environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed as AWS Lambda in a VPC with subnets tagged 'internal-processing' (subnet-0a3f8e, subnet-0b7c2d) in us-east-1a/1b. Route table rtb-04ae91 associated with both subnets contains only local route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoint for any AWS service, and no internet gateway route. Lambda function has reserved concurrency of 5. Lambda timeout: 3 seconds. The function's execution role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/LambdaProcessingBoundary) that denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface for any subnet outside the two listed. Security group sg-0f4a82 allows no outbound traffic (egress rules: none). CloudWatch Logs delivery relies on a cross-account Kinesis Firehose with VPC endpoint in a separate monitoring VPC, not accessible from the Lambda subnets.

config.route_table: rtb-04ae91 (local only, no NAT, no IGW)
